title: Prävention im Fokus: Polizei Berlin lädt zur Sonderberatung am Tag des Einbruchschutzes am 25. Oktober 2026 ein

extraction.summaryEn: Police and a carpentry guild invite the public to a free burglary-prevention consultation at police headquarters on 25 October 2026. A demonstration of a break-in attempt on a security window is planned for 13:00.
